doctrine.meaning: Checked-in record of Drizzle/ORM declarations that are NOT runtime-required-now. Their physical absence must NEVER fail schema:contract:verify. This artifact exists so the permanent contract system does not later 'rediscover' intentionally rejected schema requirements and recreate the stale-ORM-as-canonical mistake the audit eliminated.

classVocabulary.STALE_RUNTIME_ASSUMPTION: Runtime code referenced a column that has no physical existence and is a rename/removed concept; consumers are rewritten, not the schema.
classVocabulary.INCIDENTAL_ONLY: Declared in Drizzle but never consumed by any canonical-43 path; trim the Drizzle declaration.
classVocabulary.NON_RUNTIME_ORM_DRIFT: ORM-declared columns not exercised by any current runtime path (NOT_REQUIRED_NOW); may become REQUIRED_LATER.
classVocabulary.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No runtime path reads the table at all; declared columns are unwired.
classVocabulary.NON_BLOCKING_SEMANTIC: Column exists physically; only its representation/type differs from the Drizzle declaration. Not a 42703 execution blocker. Type adjudication deferred.
classVocabulary.SECURITY_SENSITIVE_DO_NOT_RESTORE: PII/2FA columns that must NOT be materialised physically merely because a full-shape Drizzle read declares them; fix is to narrow the projection.
